title: Robin na Hood
style: Phonk heist trap with hyper-speed momentum, skittering syncopated drums, rattling hats, and a tense jailbreak pulse; verse rides lean and breathless, pre-chorus tightens with shouted counts and filtered rises, chorus slams into gang vocals and chopped English licks. Close-mic male vocal with doubled ad-libs, delay throws on anchor words, siren sweeps, brake-squeal fills, and gritty wide mix with hard low-end bounce., bounce, fake, rock
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Maths driver, delta alpha plan
Hyper speed, I can, you got this, man
The mansion blinked, then locked again
Unit 336 on the scan
Sirens sound, we slide the lane
Fake a break, then break the frame
Polícia fala, we don’t stay tame
Here’s my boys, thrash this toy

[Pre-Chorus]
Take the right lane
No delay
Cash back drop
What a shock, aye
Chase and cage
Free birds rock
Math Driver
Set the slot

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good!
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock
A robin in the hood
But it’s for good!

[Verse 2]
Thrash this toy, make it shake
Sneaky phonk, thrift drift break
Give them rage in our cage
We burn the page, we flip the stage
Math Driver, the architect
The plan, the dream, done safe, done set
Our robin, our robin, no regret
Out of the mansion, don’t forget

[Pre-Chorus]
You heard the sarg
Keep it low
Chase and cage
Then let it go
Extra stripe
For no rage
We hit that door
Then we change the page

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good!
Cash back drop, what a shock
Chase and cage, free birds rock
A robin in the hood
But it’s for good!

[Bridge]
Sand box city, eyes full of sand
Where are my toys? We don’t understand
Bored stare, but we take the stand
G4 hyperspeed, we take the land
VDS Mansion, no way back
We go now, on the track
Delta track, D J Zyn Rose
Pedals everywhere, watch it go

[Final Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah, robin for good!
Busta’ em like we should
Ha bro, if we could
A robin in the hood
Next track, still good!
